title: VFX Graph production: the com.cuvara.vfx package (UnityVFX) and the Factory workflow that reads a style profile, generates textures, builds effects from recipes and play-tests them
goal: Agents author game effects with VFX Graph through a new Unity package and a Factory workflow: read the project's vfx-style profile, generate textures through asset-gen and ComfyUI, build the effect from a recipe in the agent-owned Sandbox project, capture and lint it, then a person reviews it in Play mode. Design contract of the package: UnityVFX Documentation~/DESIGN.md (the agent interface there is binding for the plugin tasks). Owner decisions: realistic base style; CC0 rigged test characters; repo Cuvara/UnityVFX public, created only after the owner accepted the play-test; no tag. Model rule: the registry model policy (pipeline.models) applies; the owner revoked the plan-scoped Fable/Opus override on 2026-11-27. Tasks pkg-core, assetgen-vfx-purposes and repo-unityvfx were implemented under that override and keep their recorded verdicts. Planning: done in plan mode with scout and Plan agents instead of a dispatched planner worker (named in the run report).

tasks.objective: Add four asset-gen purposes for effect textures under templates/assetgen/purposes/, each with handoff_domain vfx, default_family vfx, the image-generate template and an opaque pure-black background: vfx-flipbook (frames in a declared columns x rows grid), vfx-noise-tileable (tileable on both axes, uses the existing png-tileable QA), vfx-trail (landscape, tileable on the x axis only: extend the tileable QA with an axis option), vfx-sprite (one centred glow, flare, puff or debris shape). Alpha extraction, channel packing and power-of-two resize are not asset-gen's job: the gen-run binds the output hashes and the image service ignores the requested size, so those transforms belong to the consuming package's import tool; say so in the purpose constraints and in docs/architecture/domains/assetgen.md. tasks.objective: Add the deterministic VFX helpers, written against the formats in UnityVFX Documentation~/DESIGN.md and Schemas~/ (recipe, capture stats, inspect output). (1) The style profile format: docs/schemas/kinds/vfx-style.schema.json and the skeleton templates/vfx/vfx-style.md. A vfx-style artifact is one per project and binding: palette and colour ramps per element, HDR intensity bands per importance tier (primary, secondary, ambient), timing ratios (anticipation, impact, dissipation, each a min and max share of the duration), texture conventions (max size, allowed flipbook grids, channel packing, colour space), allowed output types, blend modes and shaders, per-platform budgets (max alive particles, max systems, max texture memory), the capture viewing conditions (camera, lighting, seed) and the asset-gen style id it maps to. (2) scripts/vfx/vfx_style.py: show (print the resolved profile) and lint --style <profile> --recipe <file> [--inspect <file>] [--stats <file>] [--spec <file>], output schema rpg-factory.vfx-lint/1 with one row per rule (id, state PASS, FAIL, WARN or NOT_AVAILABLE when its input is absent, evidence): recipe schema id and VFX Graph version, phase timing sums and ratios, HDR colour values inside the band of the effect's tier, palette membership within a hue tolerance, texture size, grid and colour space, allowed output, blend and shader, capacity and alive.peak against the budget of each platform, capture viewing conditions equal to the profile's, recipe hash in the stats equal to the recipe. Exit 0 no FAIL, 1 a FAIL, 3 a required input missing, 2 usage. (3) scripts/vfx/vfx_plan.py with data in scripts/vfx/data/: output schema rpg-factory.vfx-plan/1; for an effect id it reports the state of the five production steps (style profile present and approved, texture gen-runs and their approval, recipe and built asset, capture and lint, vfx-asset record), the missing inputs and the lead route; it writes nothing; exit 0 PLAN or NOT_VFX, 3 NEEDS_CONTEXT, 2 usage. (4) scripts/adapters/vfx/vfxgraph.py: text-only reader of a .vfx file and its .meta (asset GUID, system capacities, referenced GUIDs) plus a stats.json, for the quality plugin; scripts/adapters/vfx/unity.py stays for Shuriken prefabs. (5) docs/schemas/vfx-capture.schema.json mirroring the package's capture schema id cuvara.vfx-capture/1 (the fields lint reads). (6) tests/vfx-production.test.sh with fixtures under tests/fixtures/vfx/ (a good and a bad recipe, inspect and stats files, a profile): every lint rule has a PASS and a FAIL case; the plan states are covered; the adapter reads a fixture .vfx. Read-only scripts: no fetch, no writes into repos, state through scripts/lib/fstate.py. One fragment changelog.d/vfx-engine.md.
